data.description: During the Stage-2 eval (LP-0MV881PO8003QAAF), a 16.7h gap was found in /var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log for 2026-10-16 06:59:09 → 23:40:53 IST. This removes the entire daytime fast-mode window (10:00-23:40) when the 15s lease was live, invalidating the canonical 24h comparison for capture/busy/denials. The proxy booted at 23:40:53 (Logging initialised line), so the gap spans the period when the proxy should have been running with the Stage-2 config. Discovered during the eval; needs root-cause (log rotation vs outage).
data.title: Proxy log gap 2026-10-16 06:59-23:40: missing Stage-2 eval window
